sloka: मन्द प्रख्यायमानेन रूपेण रुचिर प्रभाम् ।पिनद्धाम् धूम जालेन शिखाम् इव विभावसोः ॥५-१५-२०॥
transliteration: manda prakhyāyamānena rūpeṇa rucira prabhām ।pinaddhām dhūma jālena śikhām iva vibhāvasoḥ ॥5-15-20॥

translations.english: Her form was faintly recognisable. She had a lovely radiance on account of her beautiful form. She looked like the tip of burning fire engulfed in a cloud of smoke.
